note: Source of truth for routing rules. This shipped file is a GENERIC EXAMPLE skeleton — the five default groupings plus universal subfolder types. It is illustrative, not your taxonomy: your real structure grows lazily in your on-disk .tidy-rules.json and in an optional per-drive <root>/.organizer/templates.json override (deep-merged on top, never shipped). When a file matches a template entry not yet on disk, propose creates the subfolder AND records the rule in the parent's .tidy-rules.json (learning loop).

Q1_groupings.name: ENTERTAINMENT
Q1_groupings.description: Music, movies, TV shows, books, audiobooks, comics, graphic novels, games, and hobby content — leisure not tied to paid work in ENTERTAINMENT

Q1_groupings.name: PERSONAL
Q1_groupings.description: Personal photos, financial records, medical documents, government IDs, admin paperwork, resumes, and personal writing — files belonging to you as a private individual, not tied to a company or project in PERSONAL

Q1_groupings.name: WORK
Q1_groupings.description: Work files tied to a company you run or paid client work — projects, deliverables, admin, finance, branding in WORK

Q1_groupings.name: EDUCATION
Q1_groupings.description: Postgraduate applications, dissertation and coursework, academic papers, research notes, study materials in EDUCATION

Q1_groupings.name: RESOURCES
Q1_groupings.description: Cross-domain shared assets — fonts, blank templates, stock images not tied to a project in RESOURCES

prefix_propagation.note: Naming convention: the Q1 grouping name propagates as a prefix to its Q2 children (PERSONAL/PERSONAL Financial/, ENTERTAINMENT/ENTERTAINMENT Music/), EXCEPT WORK, which does not propagate to its company/client children (WORK/[Company]/, not WORK/WORK [Company]/). Company names propagate to their project children (WORK/[Company]/[Company] [Project]/). Deeper levels (Scripts, Financials, References, per-person folders, compound children like Bills/Invoices) do NOT carry prefixes — those are universal subfolder types whose context is established by ancestry.

admin.note: Company-wide admin documents not tied to a single project.

brand_client.note: A consulting client whose deliverables are branding/marketing assets.

personal_tree_root.note: A PERSONAL or EDUCATION subfolder that splits by person. The owner plus any household/family members are the core folders; extended-family or other named people get a [Person Name] pattern folder created on demand.

personal_resumes_person.note: A person folder inside PERSONAL Resumes — holds that person's CVs/resumes. Templates live as a SIBLING of person folders (PERSONAL Resumes/Templates/), not inside any person folder.

photos_root.note: Photos organised by year then month. Year folders contain 'Month YY' subfolders (e.g. 'April 24'). Previously-bundled image sets preserved under photos/ from prior organisation.

flat.note: A leaf parent — files go directly inside. No further subfolder structure expected.

service_client.note: An individual client whose work is delivered as personal services/deliverables.

company.note: A company you run or a client umbrella under which multiple projects sit. Children are Admin + per-project folders + per-client folders, carrying the company prefix (e.g. WORK/[Company]/[Company] Admin, WORK/[Company]/[Company] [Project]). Per-company rules seed which child a file belongs to, since project lists differ.

project.note: A single project or engagement under a company. Holds that project's working files.

Scripts.description: Script or working-draft documents for this project — drafts, revisions, working text in Scripts

Schedules.description: Schedules, timelines, calendars, and date-planning documents in Schedules

Docs.description: General documents for this project — briefs, info sheets, notes, lists, and miscellaneous paperwork in Docs

References.description: Reference material gathered for this project — source images, research, scouting/location photos, product imagery, inspiration in References

Legal.description: Legal documents — MOUs and agreements, authority letters, contracts, employment letters, disputes in Legal

Financials.description: Financial documents — bills, invoices, advances, expense reports, payment summaries, receipts, bank statements, tax documents in Financials

Promotional Assets.description: Social media ads, posters, marketing assets, promotional announcements in Promotional Assets

Branding Materials.description: Brand assets — logos, icons, colour variants, letterheads, master design files (.afdesign, .psd, .ai) in Branding Materials

Templates.description: Blank templates — billing templates, letterheads, invoice templates, expense sheet templates, stationery in Templates

Planning.description: Cross-project planning documents — schedules, company-level plans in Planning

Admin.description: Company-wide admin documents — templates, legal docs, financials, references, branding materials, Notion exports in Admin

PERSONAL Photos.description: Personal photos — faces, social events, meals, travel, everyday life in PERSONAL Photos

PERSONAL Financial.description: Personal finance — bank statements, tax docs, receipts, invoices, mutual funds, loan agreements for personal accounts and company-related personal tax work in PERSONAL Financial

PERSONAL Medical.description: Medical documents — health reports, prescriptions, lab results, hospital bills, medical-device / health-monitoring data in PERSONAL Medical

PERSONAL Admin.description: Personal admin — visa applications, insurance, NDAs, government forms, general personal admin paperwork in PERSONAL Admin

PERSONAL ID and Documents.description: Personal identity documents — ID cards, passports, certificates, degree certificates, national ID, tax ID in PERSONAL ID and Documents

PERSONAL Resumes.description: CV and resume files — job applications, portfolio CVs, resume templates in PERSONAL Resumes

PERSONAL Writing.description: Personal writing — drafts, essays, creative writing in PERSONAL Writing

ENTERTAINMENT Music.description: Audio files — songs, soundtracks, lossless and lossy audio in ENTERTAINMENT Music

ENTERTAINMENT Movies and TV Shows.description: Video files for movies and TV series — .mp4, .mkv, .avi, .mov, .mxf, plus matching posters and subtitle sidecars in ENTERTAINMENT Movies and TV Shows

ENTERTAINMENT Books and Audiobooks.description: Ebook formats (epub, mobi, azw, pdf) and audiobook files in ENTERTAINMENT Books and Audiobooks

ENTERTAINMENT Comics.description: Comic books and graphic novels — PDF/CBR/CBZ, manga, adult/mature comics in ENTERTAINMENT Comics

ENTERTAINMENT Role Playing Games.description: Tabletop RPG rulebooks, campaign modules, character sheets, session notes in ENTERTAINMENT Role Playing Games

EDUCATION Masters Applications.description: Masters and postgraduate application materials — motivation letters, personal statements, MPhil/PhD proposals, enrolment docs in EDUCATION Masters Applications

EDUCATION Research.description: Academic papers, journal articles, news coverage, research notes, and topic research projects in EDUCATION Research

RESOURCES Templates.description: Blank document templates not tied to any specific company — .dotx, .xltx, .potx in RESOURCES Templates

Joint.description: Files belonging jointly to multiple members of the household — joint accounts, joint property, joint applications, joint correspondence in Joint

[Person Name].description: Per-person folder for someone outside the immediate household — extended family, friend, or other named individual whose docs are stored here. Folder name is the person's first name (or full name when disambiguation is needed) in [Person Name]

Bills.description: Bills from vendors, suppliers, and service providers in Bills

Invoices.description: Invoices issued or received in Invoices

Advances.description: Advance payments made or received, advance receipts in Advances

Payment Summaries.description: Payment summary documents, payment reconciliation sheets in Payment Summaries

Receipts.description: Loose receipts not part of an expense report in Receipts

Bank Statements.description: Bank statements, credit card statements, monthly account statements — personal accounts and accounts attached to company work in Bank Statements

Tax Documents.description: Tax returns (ITR), capital gains statements, AIS compliance documents — personal and company-related tax filings in Tax Documents

MOUs and Agreements.description: Memorandums of understanding, partnership agreements, signed agreements, loan agreements, mutual fund forms in MOUs and Agreements

Authority Letters.description: Authority letters, board resolutions, power-of-attorney letters, signing-authority documents in Authority Letters

Contracts.description: Service contracts, employment contracts, vendor contracts in Contracts

Appointment and Employment Letters.description: Appointment letters, offer letters, employment letters in Appointment and Employment Letters

Disputes.description: Dispute correspondence, dismissal letters, legal notices, complaint replies in Disputes

Pitch Docs.description: Pitch decks, pitch documents, treatment notes in Pitch Docs

Info Sheets.description: Information sheets and general non-document reference notes in Info Sheets

Locations.description: Location photos and site-visit notes in Locations

Product Images.description: Product catalog shots, equipment photography, brand product imagery in Product Images

Statements And Proposals.description: Motivation letters, personal statements, MPhil/PhD research proposals in Statements And Proposals

Archived.description: Offers and documents from non-active programmes (rejected or not accepted) in Archived

Future Planning.description: Future postgraduate planning notes, programme shortlists, timelines in Future Planning

Academic Papers.description: Academic papers, journal articles, thesis chapters, conference papers in Academic Papers

Notes.description: Research notes, bibliographies, reading lists, methodology notes in Notes

Digital Tools.description: Research on digital tools, software, and technique references in Digital Tools

Corpus.description: Source corpus — datasets, raw text, transcripts in Corpus

Output.description: Generated or exported output files produced by a tool or process in Output

Backups.description: Backup snapshots and zips in Backups

_Junk.description: Download-site cruft folders — never scanned in _Junk

_Unsorted.description: Loose audio files without album context — move to (YYYY) AlbumName when identified in _Unsorted

_Inbox.description: Files awaiting routing to a correct destination — review individually in _Inbox

[Institution].description: Institution-specific enrolment documents — offer letter, acceptance, fees, timetable, programme docs in [Institution]

[YYYY].description: Year folder containing month subfolders like 'Month YY' (e.g. 'April 24') in [YYYY]

[(YYYY) AlbumName].description: Per-album folder. Files named 'AlbumName - SongTitle - Artist.ext'. Year prefix when known; artist in parens for non-film albums in [(YYYY) AlbumName]

[Movie Title (YYYY)].description: Per-movie folder. Contains video, poster, and subtitle sidecar all sharing the base filename in [Movie Title (YYYY)]

[Series Name].description: Series folder — contains 'Season N' subfolders with episodes and per-episode sidecars in [Series Name]

[Series Title].description: Per-book or per-audiobook series folder. Audiobooks use 'Series Title; Read by Narrator [FORMAT]' in [Series Title]

[Game Name].description: Per-game folder for a specific RPG. Contains Manual/, Characters/, Assets/, Sessions/ in [Game Name]

[ProjectName].description: A single project folder containing that project's working files (docs, schedules, references, legal, financials, deliverables) in [ProjectName]
